cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.
